mapillary.attribution_rule: self-hosted images: visibly display the Mapillary logo and link to the Mapillary image page

meta.share_alike: CC BY-SA 4.0: thumbnails (downscaled adaptations) are redistributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 with per-image attribution
meta.coverage_note: 400 real street-level photos within the block bbox + 50 m (KartaView 38, Mapillary 362). Photos are shown as published (platform-blurred), never synthesised; x/y are local metres from meta.origin (Web-Mercator/k convention, y north); heading_deg is the camera compass bearing (null = not recorded).
meta.privacy: No person-identifying processing; whole frames downscaled only; KartaView frames without platform blur status BLURRED are metadata-only.
meta.artifact_csp_note: Artifact pages block external URLs, so only local thumbs render inside the artifact; 'url' links open the platform page.
